objective: Repair the security and consistency findings in holyagent setup and doctor so setup children ignore the current project's Bun and npm config and doctor agrees with setup about where tools are found.
scope: Blocking security finding (Medium): packages/runtime/src/setup/shell.ts:97 runs `bun add -g billion-context`, `bun add -g ctx7`, `bili plugin install claude` and `ctx7 setup` with the process cwd (the user's project, cli/main.ts:36), so a project bunfig.toml, .npmrc or .env can redirect the install registry or preload code. Run every setup child from a neutral directory (the home directory), and start `bun add -g` with `--no-env-file` and `--config=<the plugin's empty-bunfig.toml>` so project config cannot change it; keep ignoring a project .npmrc (a neutral cwd covers it; set npm_config_userconfig only if needed).

Blocking stale text: packages/runtime/src/instructions/requirements/cache.md:7 says "the public CLI sets `subagentPromptCacheTtl` to 1h"; the public CLI is deleted and `holyagent setup` writes that key now. Update it and anything generated from it.

Non-blocking, fix alongside: doctor.ts:28 checkCommand uses shell.which without includeBunBin while setup and check.ts:21 search Bun's bin directory; make doctor agree (and name the PATH hint when found only in Bun's bin). json-file.ts:52: treat a 0-byte or whitespace-only settings.json as an empty object, as a missing file is.
constraints: Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on or before a risky step. When the work is done and checked, stop and report; do not add unrequested features, tests, files or refactors (name them in the report).

No version-control writes, no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; report changed paths. If `mise run build` removes the vendored tools, run `git restore packages/integrations/claude/dist/scripts/vendor`.
Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md (Effect, Effect Schema, Bun Shell, JSDoc, mise run build after plugin source changes).

notes:
- `bun add -g` sets `--config` to `EMPTY_BUNFIG`, which resolves to `join(import.meta.dir, "empty-bunfig.toml")`. In the built plugin that is `scripts/empty-bunfig.toml`, beside `holyagent.js`. Run from source it points at a file that does not exist; the tests only check the argument string, so they do not exercise this.
- I did not set `npm_config_userconfig`. Running from the home directory is enough to ignore a project `.npmrc`. A user-level `~/.npmrc` still applies, which is intended.
- Doctor now passes `bili` or `ctx7` found only in Bun's bin directory, with the hint "(not on PATH; add its directory to PATH)", and fails only when neither location has it. This matches the SessionStart check. The fail text changed from "not found on PATH" to "not found on PATH or in Bun's bin directory".
- `Shell.run` now requires `{ cwd }`. The test fake records `cwd` and can model commands found only in Bun's bin directory.
- A test that listed an empty file as invalid JSON was updated, because an empty file is now `{}`.
- The `docs/` pages that describe `doctor` output were not checked for the new wording, since `docs/` is outside my ownership paths.
